steps.fact: Candidate left referent registry:11847201 maps to registry row 11847201 naming HELION ROBOTICS LIMITED.
Candidate right referent registry:11847299 maps to registry row 11847299 naming HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD.
Commercial notes state that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity.
Commercial notes state that Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company from that Helion Robotics legal entity.
